column2: [intro]
There's no reason to let life get you down,
Even when things start to spin around,
We'll take it lightly, no need to frown,
We'll turn heads, spinning off the ground!
In this strange world where all is obscure,
I often wonder, what's the surest cure?
It's a real puzzle, an enigma to unravel,
But with music, all our troubles we'll travel!
Some say we need to be serious and grand,
But I prefer humor, it's the better stand,
We'll make people laugh, even through strife,
With jokes and puns, we'll lighten up life!
In this strange world where all is obscure,
I often wonder, what's the surest cure?
It's a real puzzle, an enigma to unravel,
But with music, all our troubles we'll travel!
[ solo ]
So, we leave the past behind with grace,
We move forward lightly, with no trace,
We'll savor life, like a caramel apple bite,
And make hearts dance with our melodies bright!
[outro]
